_comment: squid-policy database. Edit via the dashboard or `squid-policy set`. Groups are evaluated in the documented order; an IP may belong to exactly one group.

options.note: Example Bank downstream proxy (behind F5, upstream Cisco WSA)

groups.name: Quarantined hosts (no internet)
groups._note: add a compromised host here for an instant internet cut-off; applies to HTTP, HTTPS and (with rules-pre.conf) SSH-over-CONNECT

groups.name: IT / security team (unrestricted)
groups._note: Opsuser's IT security host. Bypasses the policy tier, NOT the security tier.

groups.name: Kiosk / ATM hosts (allowlist only)
groups._note: allowlist-only hosts. The protected list (payment rails, Windows Update, .examplebank.internal) is added automatically, so adding a PayGate2/PaymentGateway1/NID host here will NOT break those rails.

groups.name: General staff (extra restrictions)
groups._note: add staff subnets like 10.60.11.0/24. Keep 10.60.11.222 out of this if it is in it_admins — an IP may only be in one group.
